Logo 8 inch ka karoon ya 10 inch ka? 🤔 Print se pehle T-shirt pe dekh lo 👇

1️⃣ DTF website pe design upload karo
2️⃣ Design ke neeche "See on T-shirt" dabao
3️⃣ Design size L ki T-shirt pe asli size mein dikhta hai
4️⃣ + dabao bada, − dabao chhota, Back pe peeche bhi dekho

Jo size pasand aaye, usi size ka DTF print milega. T-shirt sirf dekhne ke liye hai.

👉 dtf.bulkplaintshirt.com/tshirt
